# /crav1-build-features

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [Build tasks](../../from-plan-to-build.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-build-features/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Serial board: build several ready specs one slug after another in this checkout.

Serial board of ready slugs: `feat/<slug>` from default, then that spec’s build-tasks loop; no parallel, no push, no PR.

1.99.0: `feat/<slug>` forks from the into branch (Merges into, else default), a task naming a base branch is blocked.

1.64.0: tasks with `(branch: …)` are built on that branch; the board shows `done (n branches not merged)`.

## Runs when

Several specs, one after another. Called by the user.

## Prompts

Prompt budget: 3 (the most prompts in one run, the closing yes included). A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: Ready spec folders on the default branch.

Reads ready spec folders already on the default branch.

## Writes

In short: The commit-style rule once, and a `feat/<slug>` checkout; one worker per `T#` writes that task's code, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, `fix-log.md` when a fix runs, and the commits.

Writes the commit-style rule once when it is missing, and a `feat/<slug>` checkout from default per slug.

## Does not

Leaves product code, commits, `spec.md`, push, and the pull request alone in this chat.

Limits and exceptions: one ready slug stops and points at [`/crav1-build-tasks`](crav1-build-tasks.md) without running it. When a slice is marked done or retired, it asks once whether to run [`/crav1-refresh-system-notes`](crav1-refresh-system-notes.md) and does not run it.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-open-pr`](crav1-open-pr.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-create-feature-branch`](crav1-create-feature-branch.md) for that checkout, without re-prompting, and `crav1-build-task-agent` one `T#` at a time.

Lane: Build. Group: Build. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).
